label: D1 late in episode (low value) with a moderate lean toward a2
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never GO/D2) and only in the last ~15 trials of an episode (91% of mass at ep_trial 90-99, none before 60), where the value head output is lowest (97% of mass in the bottom value bin, < 5.22). Almost all activations (99.5%) occur when the policy logit(a1)-logit(a2) is moderately negative (-4.4 to -1.5), i.e. the agent leans toward a2 without being certain; upcoming choice is a2 in essentially every activation and the previous choice was a2. Reward input 1 at D1 (previous trial rewarded) carries 89% of the mass and raises the rate 4x; good=S2 (episode started with S1 good and later reversed) is enriched. The recorded predicate uses only observed inputs and the model own value/policy readouts: dev recall 0.96, mass recall 0.97, but precision only ~0.11. Adding prev_reward==1, ep_trial>=90 or tighter value cuts did not push precision above ~0.16, so firing within this late-episode a2-leaning D1 context is sparse (~10%) and not captured by any trial-history variable checked. Does not fire on a1-leaning D1 steps, early or mid-episode trials, or any GO/D2 step.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over trial before (D1: a2 S1 u, ?) and last trial (D1: a2 S2 r, a2 S2 u, ?); timing cues that raise it most: phase=D1 & ep_dec=9, phase=D1 & ep_dec=8, rel=-3.
